title: Code Insights DB Reporting Agent Skill

questions.prompt: Where should the agent skill be installed and made available?
questions.description: Determines whether this skill is available globally across all projects in Antigravity or isolated in this repository.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Both global (~/.gemini/skills/) and local repo (.agents/skills/) so it can be used anywhere or committed with the repository.

options.label: Both: Install globally (~/.gemini/skills/code-insights-reports) and copy to local repo (.agents/skills/code-insights-reports)

questions.prompt: Which analytical reporting dimensions should the skill specialize in?
questions.description: Select the core report workflows and SQL recipes to document and support.
questions.recommendedAnswer: All key dimensions: session reflection, cost & token economics, friction & course corrections, prompt quality trends, tool benchmarking, and ad-hoc SQL.

options.label: Session Reflection: Cross-session summaries, key decisions, architectural learnings, and weekly/monthly digests
Cost & Token Economics: Model token consumption, prompt caching efficiency, cost per project, and burn rate
Friction & Failure Loops: Course corrections, rage loops, abandoned sessions, and friction taxonomy
Prompt Quality: SFL breakdown (Ideational/Interpersonal/Textual), score trends, and prompt optimization suggestions
Tool Comparison: Comparing session volume, efficiency, and satisfaction across Claude Code, Antigravity, OpenCode, Mistral, Hermes, etc.
Ad-Hoc SQL Querying: Answering open-ended natural language questions by synthesizing safe SQLite queries

questions.prompt: How should the agent execute queries against ~/.code-insights/data.db?
questions.description: Determines whether the skill relies on sqlite3 CLI commands, dedicated Node.js helper scripts, existing CLI commands, or a hybrid approach.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Hybrid: Use sqlite3 CLI with strict read-only flags and pre-built helper scripts/queries for complex aggregations and formatting.

options.label: Hybrid: sqlite3 CLI for ad-hoc queries + dedicated helper script(s) in skill for complex multi-table aggregations
Direct sqlite3 CLI only: Document query templates and recipes to execute directly via bash sqlite3
Node.js Helper Scripts: Self-contained Node scripts in the skill (scripts/) that handle db connection, formatting, and safety

questions.prompt: What output formats should the reporting skill produce?
questions.description: How the agent should present findings when running reports.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Structured Markdown reports with summary metrics, tables, and optional artifact file generation for deep-dive reports.

options.label: Executive Markdown Briefs: Concise conversational summaries with key takeaways and actionable recommendations
Tabular Data: Formatted ASCII/Markdown tables with rankings, percentiles, and counts
Saved Artifact Reports: Writing detailed reports to disk (e.g. reports/ or brain artifacts) for review
JSON Data Export: Structured JSON output for downstream tooling or pipes

questions.prompt: What database safety and concurrency guards should be enforced in the skill?
questions.description: code-insights runs SQLite in WAL mode with active background workers and dashboard writes.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Strict read-only query mode (preventing any accidental write locks or mutations) and handling WAL mode concurrency cleanly.

options.label: Strict Read-Only: Enforce URI mode=ro or PRAGMA query_only=ON so the agent cannot mutate data
Busy Timeout: Set 5000ms busy_timeout so reads don't fail when the sync hook or worker is writing
Schema Drift Check: Verify schema version (current v18) or table existence before complex joins
